include("$ENV{TACTILITY_SDK_PATH}/TactilitySDK.cmake")

file(GLOB_RECURSE SOURCE_FILES Source/*.c*)

# Generated by ../build-rust.sh: defines DICES_STATICLIB (path to
# libdices_badge.a) and DICES_LINK_LIBS (the Rust std libraries to link after
# it, as reported by rustc's native-static-libs).
set(LINK_CMAKE "${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/../generated/link.cmake")
if(NOT EXISTS "${LINK_CMAKE}")
    message(FATAL_ERROR "${LINK_CMAKE} not found: run ../build-rust.sh first")
endif()
include("${LINK_CMAKE}")

tactility_component_register(
    SRCS ${SOURCE_FILES}
)

# The Rust core: linked whole (linkme's distributed slices live in linker
# sections of archive members the linker would otherwise discard), followed by
# whatever Rust std needs on this target.
target_link_libraries(${COMPONENT_LIB} PRIVATE
    "-Wl,--whole-archive"
    "${DICES_STATICLIB}"
    "-Wl,--no-whole-archive"
    ${DICES_LINK_LIBS}
)
